title: Add PostgreSQL repository skeleton

context.summary: Add the repository contract and Drizzle repository layer needed before API runtime wiring.
context.background: The initial PRD roadmap ended at TASK-13. The next MVP blocker is persistence: API, MCP, CLI and Hermes surfaces exist, but they cannot be wired until PostgreSQL repositories exist.

in: Add core project, peer, session and message repository contracts.
Export project and session contracts from @mindory/core.
Add Drizzle-backed repositories for projects, peers, sessions, messages, documents, memory claims, document chunk search and processing jobs.
Keep API routes as explicit placeholders until a later runtime wiring task.
Add database repository validation to repository checks.
Update architecture, API, database, memory and README docs.
out: Wire repositories into Fastify API routes.
Create a database connection lifecycle for the API server.
Run migrations against a live database.
Implement vector search, pgvector migrations or embedding storage.
Install dependencies if pnpm is unavailable in the local environment.

acceptance_criteria: @mindory/core exports project, peer, session and message repository contracts.
The database repository layer includes project and peer repositories.
The database repository layer includes session and message repositories.
The database repository layer implements the existing DocumentRepository contract.
The database repository layer implements the existing MemoryRepository contract.
The database repository layer implements ProcessingJobStore.
The database repository layer includes a placeholder text-based document chunk search repository.
API routes remain explicit not_implemented placeholders until a later wiring task.
Repository checks include database repository validation.

manual_checks: Confirm repository code lives in @mindory/db and API route files do not import @mindory/db.
Confirm no pgvector/vector migration or API runtime wiring was added.

risks: Local pnpm is unavailable in the current environment, so TypeScript execution may need to wait until dependencies are installed.
The repository layer is structurally validated but not exercised against a live PostgreSQL database in this task.
Text-based chunk search is a temporary repository placeholder and is not vector search.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch can be merged into master without unrelated changes.
